Booking is easy! 😊
1. Click on any service from the home page
2. Select 'I'm a Customer' and log in
3. Browse available services and click 'Add'
4. Enter your address in the cart
5. Click 'Confirm Booking' — done! ✅

To join as a service provider:
1. Click on any service page
2. Select 'I'm a Provider'
3. Register or log in
4. Add your services with name, price, duration and description

You'll be visible to customers immediately! 🚀

We accept multiple payment methods:
💳 Credit / Debit Cards
📱 UPI (GPay, PhonePe, Paytm)
🏦 Net Banking
💵 Cash on Service

Payment is collected after the service is completed.
You can cancel a booking up to 24 hours before the scheduled time from your account dashboard. For urgent cancellations, contact our support at support@servicex.com.
Prices vary by service and provider. You can view exact pricing on each service page before booking. Prices are set by verified providers and are fully transparent — no hidden charges! 💰
